name: Side-tab accent border
description: A thick colored border on one side of a card is the most recognizable tell of AI-generated UI. Use a subtler accent or remove it entirely; if a stripe must mark state, keep it thin and pair it with a second cue such as an icon or label.

name: Low contrast text
description: Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast against its background.

name: Overused font
description: A default font choice that reads as generated.

name: Hard offset shadow
description: A crisp shadow pushed 4px or more; fine if neobrutalism is the intent.
